versions.changelog:
- Removed the file agents/openai.yaml.
- No public-facing features or functionality were changed.

- Streamlined and clarified descriptions in both English and Chinese for easier understanding.
- Updated capability bullets, best-for audience, and example queries for more practical guidance.
- Improved output format section to clearly set user expectations.
- Added clearer instructions for when to use the skill and how requests are handled.
- Refined notes, data limitations, and legal disclaimer for better transparency.

- Streamlined and updated all documentation for clarity and new use cases.
- Expanded English and Chinese example queries for broader job search scenarios.
- Shortened skill description and overview for faster understanding.
- Added clear output expectations, best-fit user guidance, and working rules.
- Replaced APPEAL documentation with a new README and agent configuration file.

- Official provider domain updated from h1bfriend.com to h1bfinder.com throughout the skill.
- API requirement now specifies h1bfinder.com.
- Version incremented to 1.1.0.
- License acceptance field added.
- No changes to features or example prompts; data source and workflow remain the same.

- Added a detailed use case example to clarify typical prompts and outputs.
- Updated metadata structure (added homepage field).
- Removed inner documentation and setup files for a cleaner repo.
- Added APPEAL.md files; removed redundant SKILL.md/test files.

- Initial release of H1B Finder skill providing AI-assisted H1B employer and salary intelligence.
- Leverages 4M+ official Department of Labor records, including FY2025 data.
- Supports sponsor ranking/filtering, salary insights, approval signal analysis, and company comparisons.
- Real-time queries to structured h1bfriend.com API for data-backed analysis.
- Includes bilingual (English/Chinese) documentation and example prompts.
- Emphasizes privacy and informational use; not for processing personal/sensitive data.
